display.purpose: The empty-viewer heading only. The one place type is allowed to be large.

title.purpose: Panel headings, inspector title, timeline heading, clip labels.

body.purpose: Controls, field values and labels. The default voice.

label.purpose: Catalog group headings, inspector section headings, track-section bands.

timecode.purpose: Transport and timeline readouts. Tabular figures, never prose.

mono-small.purpose: Ruler labels, clip durations, track IDs and targets, hex values.

shadows.name: clip-edge-presence
shadows.purpose: Describes a presence clip's edge against its tone. Not lift.

shadows.name: clip-edge-animation
shadows.purpose: Edge on animation pills; uses tone-fx-line.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: The only outer shadow in the system: the selected clip's hot ring.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on buttons and fields. The only duration in the system.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active-state nudge on buttons. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion disables every transition and the press nudge.

components.name: Render Button
components.description: The single commit action. Exactly one per window, always at the far right of the project bar.
components.html: <button class="ds-render"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M7 4v16l13-8z"/></svg>Render</button>
components.css: .ds-render { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #c43a26; color: #fff; font: 700 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease; } .ds-render:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c43a26 86%, #1d1d20); } .ds-render:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Every secondary command in the project bar. Label collapses to icon-only at 1100px.
components.css: .ds-text-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: #5a5a62; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; padding: 5px 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease, color .12s ease; } .ds-text-btn:hover { background: #d9d9de; color: #1d1d20; } .ds-text-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-text-btn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Every inspector value. Label left at 92px, field right; numbers tabular.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #5a5a62; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; color: #1d1d20; background: #f8f8f9; border: 1px solid #c4c4ca; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 7px; font: inherit; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color .12s ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #5a5a62; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #c43a26; outline: none; }

components.name: Panel Heading
components.description: The 30px bar that titles every panel; secondary controls align right.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; background: #e2e2e5; border-bottom: 1px solid #c4c4ca; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d20; } .ds-head select { margin-left: auto; max-width: 150px; min-height: 22px; padding: 1px 6px; background: #f8f8f9; color: #1d1d20; border: 1px solid #c4c4ca; border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Object Pool Tile
components.description: Catalog entry: a drawn glyph on a black 16:10 thumbnail over its name. Echoes the Manim stage.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 84px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #f8f8f9; border: 1px solid #c4c4ca; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: #5a5a62; } .ds-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: #000; color: #fff; } .ds-name { padding: 3px 6px 4px; font-size: 11px; color: #1d1d20; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Presence Clip
components.description: An object's span on the timeline. Tone encodes kind; duration sits right in mono; grips resize.
components.html: f(x)=x^29 s
components.css: .ds-clip { display: flex; align-items: stretch; width: 260px; height: 28px; background: #6b5aa6; color: #fff; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / .16); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-grip { width: 7px; flex: none; cursor: ew-resize; } .ds-grip:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .3); } .ds-label { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 7px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: grab; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dur { display: flex; align-items: center; padding-right: 7px; font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; opacity: .85; }

components.name: Animation Clip
components.description: A motion block. Neutral pill with a drawn AnimationIcon, so motion reads differently from presence.
components.html: Write · 1 s
components.css: .ds-fx { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; height: 20px; padding: 0 9px; background: #4b4b55; color: #fff; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2f2f36; font: 600 11px/1 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Selected Track Label
components.description: Track header in the 176px label column; the selection wash marks the active row.
components.css: .ds-track { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 7px; width: 176px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; background: #cdd9ec; color: #1d1d20; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #c4c4ca; cursor: pointer; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-track svg { color: #5a5a62; flex: none; } .ds-id { width: 22px; flex: none; font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; color: #5a5a62; }

components.name: Playhead
components.description: A 1px vermilion line with a 13px pentagon head, spanning ruler and every track.
components.css: .ds-ph-wrap { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 72px; background: #dcdce0; } .ds-ph { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 60px; width: 1px; background: #c43a26; } .ds-ph::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -6px; width: 13px; height: 13px; background: #c43a26; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 55%, 50% 100%, 0 55%); }

narrative.overview:
manim-editor looks and behaves like a compact non-linear editor, not a form with a footer. Matte graphite panels sit on a darker gutter and are separated by 2px seams, so the window reads as one machined console rather than a stack of cards. The timeline is the instrument: it owns the lower ~42% of the window, its V and A tracks carry colour by object kind, and a single hot vermilion marks the things that are live right now (Render, the playhead, the selection).

Density is high and calm: 12px Segoe UI Variable Text for the interface, Cascadia Mono wherever a value is data (timecode, ruler, track IDs, durations, hex colours, LaTeX). Objects are shown through drawn glyphs on black thumbnails, which echo the black Manim stage the user is composing for. The story the layout tells, left to right and top to bottom: pick an object from the pool, shape it in the inspector, place it in time, render, scrub the result.

Both themes are first-class. Light is cool grey graphite on a mid-grey gutter; dark is near-black graphite on a darker gutter. The stage is black in both.
keyCharacteristics: Panels on 2px gutters; no cards, no floating surfaces, no drop shadows.
One hot colour (vermilion) reserved for live state and the single commit action.
Clip colour encodes object kind; animation clips are neutral pills with a motion glyph.
Timecode and measurement are monospaced, tabular data.
Drawn, authored glyphs for every element and animation kind.

rules.name: The One Hot Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is reserved for Render, the playhead, selection rings, focus rings, the unsaved dot, the stale-preview dot and the timeline timecode. Nothing else may be hot, and no second accent hue may be introduced.

rules.name: The Tone Means Kind Rule
rules.body: A clip's colour is decided by what the object is (toneOf in Timeline.tsx), never by state or by user choice. State is shown with the hot ring, hatching and the lock, not by recolouring.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything the user reads as a measurement (time, duration, track ID, hex colour, LaTeX source) is set in Cascadia Mono with tabular figures. Prose and labels never are.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case at 11-12px. No uppercase kickers or eyebrows; weight and the muted colour carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Seams Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: Panels are separated by 2px gutters and hairlines. Nothing floats; nothing casts a shadow.

dos: Do separate surfaces with the 2px gutter and 1px hairlines, and keep new panels on panel with a 30px panel-head heading.
Do keep vermilion to Render, the playhead, selection rings, focus rings, the unsaved dot, the stale-preview dot and the timeline timecode.
Do colour new element kinds with an existing tone by family (coordinates, graph, tex, text, shape), and give new animation kinds a pill with a drawn AnimationIcon.
Do set times, durations, IDs, hex values and LaTeX in Cascadia Mono with tabular figures.
Do draw a 24-unit line glyph (round caps, 1.75 stroke) for any new element kind and show it on a black thumbnail.
Do keep the ruler, lane and playhead insets (10px start, 16px end) in sync whenever the timeline geometry changes.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: transitions off and no press nudge.
donts: Don't introduce cards, floating panels, drop shadows or translucent blur.
Don't add a second accent colour, or use vermilion for decoration, links, badges or hover states.
Don't recolour clips to show state; use the ring, hatching and lock.
Don't use stock "AI" iconography (sparkles, magic wands, robot heads) or emoji; command icons stay plain line icons at 13-15px.
Don't put the timeline back under a stacked sidebar of forms; it keeps its own full-width band.
Don't use uppercase kickers, eyebrows or display type outside the empty viewer.
Don't let the stage be anything but black.
